concerns.text: Task T017 generates `full_sample_metrics.json` containing ONLY tasks with pass_rate >= 0.80. This contradicts FR-005 (which mandates filtering for structural analysis) AND the Plan's 'Full-Sample Analysis' section which explicitly requires analyzing ALL 164 tasks (including failed code) to avoid selection bias. There is no task to generate the required 'Full Sample' dataset containing all tasks.

Tasks T014a, T014b, and T016a explicitly restrict metric extraction (radon/coverage) to 'ONLY for tasks in valid_task_ids.json' (the filtered set). This leaves the Plan's 'Full-Sample Analysis' requirement (analyze all 164 tasks) unimplemented. No task exists to compute metrics for the full dataset including those with pass_rate < 0.80.

Task T024 implements MDES calculation but lacks a task to implement the 'Achieved Power' and '95% Confidence Intervals' explicitly required by the Plan's 'FR/SC Mapping' for FR-008 and SC-005. The Plan states: 'Calculates MDES descriptively; reports Achieved Power and 95% CI', but T024 only mentions MDES.

Task T052 specifies the CodeLlama model as 'codellama-3b-q4_0.gguf' but fails to include the specific HuggingFace repository or commit hash required by Constitution Principle VII (Benchmark Integrity) and FR-001/FR-009 reproducibility mandates. No task exists to pin or verify this specific model artifact version.

Task T063 implements Little's MCAR test, but there is no task to implement the subsequent 'Bias Analysis' step described in the Plan's 'Missing Data & Bias Analysis Protocol' (comparing distribution of task difficulty between included vs excluded pairs) or the 'Reporting' step. The protocol is only partially covered.

Success Criteria SC-001 (Task-completion time) and SC-002 (Throughput) require measuring against 'documented capacity requirements' by logging `generation_duration_ms` and `tasks_per_minute`. While T002 sets up dependencies and T004 sets up logging, no task explicitly implements the instrumentation to log these specific metrics to a structured output (e.g., `data/analysis/performance.json`) for aggregation and verification.

Task T010 records the commit SHA in `data/metadata.yaml` but lacks an explicit verification step to ensure the recorded SHA matches the fetched dataset, creating a gap in Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility). A verification task or step is missing.

Task T054 implements Levene's Test and reports a p-value and boolean flag, but fails to explicitly calculate the 'observed variance difference magnitude' required by SC-006 ('measured against' clause). The task description omits the calculation of the effect size magnitude.
